sentences.en: Could you show me what you're serving in the buffet?
sentences.zh: 你能给我看看自助餐里提供的食物吗？

sentences.en: He was excommunicated for serving the Eucharist in highball glasses.
sentences.zh: 他因为在高脚杯中提供圣餐而被开除教籍。

sentences.en: You will finish serving your sentence next month, won't you?
sentences.zh: 你下个月就会完成你的刑期了吧？
